Bearer.description:
Authenticated requests must include an Authorization header with a session
ID that was retrieved from [`/api/v2/sessions`](#sessions).  The session ID
has a limited lifespan.  Access is allowed only to resources that the user is
authorized to use.
Bearer.name: Authorization

PUT_notification-webhook.description: Update the list of webhook URLs configured for receiving system notifications.

destinationApp.description: Webhook configuration destination. Possible values are - pagerduty, slack, vro, custom.

contentType.description: Webhook configuration content type for sending data to webhook destination. Possible values are - json, xml.

payload.description: Webhook configuration payload for sending data to webhook destination.

headers.description: Webhook configuration headers for sending data to webhook destination.

acceptCert.description: Webhook configuration destination certificate trust policy.

sendIndividualLogs.description: Webhook configuration for sending individual or combined notification for logs.

200.description: Successfully updated the list of webhook URLs configured for receiving system notifications.
